features: Medium Weight,Easy to Store and Use.
description: A reliable Cheese Slicer with a built in wire cutter., The wire is replaceable. Board measures 8.3 x 4.7 in(21x12cm), has non-slip rubber feet and comes in a full color box.  Clean trouble? NO! 430 Stainless-steel mesa / 304 Stainless-steel Wire Fungicides wash, high-temperature sterilization! So Easy!  Convenient storage? YES! 2CM thickness, you can put it up, stuffed into the corner :)  This attractive cheese slicer is ideal for a cheese-and-crackers presentation at a party, yet it's small enough to bring along a picnic.
